error: This could not load. Your information has not changed.
empty: Nothing here yet. Keep talking with PAI and this picture will grow.
profileIntro: Built from your words and evidence. You can always correct it.
coverageHelp: Shading means there is evidence. This is not a score.
options: Options you know & myths to check
otherHelp: Your own wording is saved as stated evidence and flagged for catalog review.
documentHelp: Upload in Documents, or attach it in your conversation. PAI will review the evidence.
journeyIntro: A conversation, not a checklist. Revisit any step when your situation changes.
pathsIntro: Compare the paths that fit you and choose one. Then ask PAI anything about it in the chat. These are possibilities, not decisions made for you.
chooseBody: This becomes your path. PAI will help you with it in the chat, and you can choose another path later.
askTopic: I chose {title}. Tell me more about this path.
pathOutdated: Older suggestion, from before fields of study
pathOutOfGroup: Not open to your current group
pathsNeedEducation: PAI needs your group or field to suggest fields of study.
findingPaths: PAI is looking at everything you have shared. New paths and how they fit you appear here in a minute. If nothing changes, tell PAI a little more about yourself first.
addOwnTitle: A path you have in mind
addOwnIntro: Any direction you are curious about. PAI will check how it fits you, the same way as the others.
addOwnPlaceholder: For example: nursing, mobile repair, graphic design

pathsFoundBody.one: One path, checked against what you shared.
pathsFoundBody.other: {count} paths, each checked against what you shared.

privacyHelp: Private interpretation stays with PAI. Nothing is shared with a university here. Per-university consent is required before any future sharing.
lag: PAI is still catching up with recent messages. Your conversation can continue.
removeHelp: Remove this from your Vault? It stays in your private history and comes back only if you share it again.
deleteHelp: This will permanently delete your account and all your data.
deleteNeedsSignIn: For your safety, sign in again, then delete your account.
onboardingRetry: Please retry to finish setting up your profile.
certaintyReply: My certainty about my direction is {value} out of {max}.

stageDescriptions.A: Your name, studies, date of birth and where you live.
stageDescriptions.B: PAI asks about your life, interests and the people around you.
stageDescriptions.C: PAI shares a first picture of you, and you correct it.
stageDescriptions.D: You go deeper on what matters most.
stageDescriptions.E: PAI draws what it knows about you from your Vault. Anything wrong, you fix in the Vault.
stageDescriptions.F: Directions worth exploring, each with a reason from your own words.
stageDescriptions.G: See two or three paths side by side: how each fits you and what it takes to get in.
stageDescriptions.H: Ask PAI in the chat about the path you are leaning towards.
stageDescriptions.I: Choose the path that is yours. You can change it later.
stageDescriptions.J: Your plan for the path you chose comes next.
stageDescriptions.K: Check in when you try something, get a result or change your mind.
